description: Unit tests for SocketBIOAdapter class, testing synchronous and asynchronous socket I/O, error handling, and self-deletion during callbacks.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapterTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for SocketBIOAdapter unit tests, implementing delegate methods and test utilities.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, enabling read-if-ready support if parameter is set.

methods.name: MakeTestSocket
methods.description: Creates and connects a mock StreamSocket for testing.

methods.name: set_reset_on_write_ready
methods.description: Sets a pointer to an adapter to reset during OnWriteReady callback.

methods.name: ExpectReadError
methods.description: Verifies that BIO_read fails with expected error and error is correctly mapped.

methods.name: ExpectBlockingRead
methods.description: Verifies that BIO_read returns a retryable error and BIO_should_read is true.

methods.name: ExpectWriteError
methods.description: Verifies that BIO_write fails with expected error and error is correctly mapped.

methods.name: ExpectBlockingWrite
methods.description: Verifies that BIO_write returns a retryable error and BIO_should_write is true.

methods.name: WaitForReadReady
methods.description: Runs event loop until OnReadReady is triggered.

methods.name: WaitForWriteReady
methods.description: Runs event loop until OnWriteReady is triggered, optionally resuming a paused socket.

methods.name: WaitForBothReady
methods.description: Runs event loop until both OnReadReady and OnWriteReady are triggered.
